title: cgmy_cert: code and results for 'Symbol-based residual certification of reduced and neural surrogates for tempered-fractional CGMY pricing'
description:
Code and result files for the article Symbol-based residual certification of reduced and neural surrogates for tempered-fractional CGMY pricing (arXiv:2611.03463). The Python package cgmy_cert assembles the Galerkin discretisation of the CGMY pricing equation from its symbol, computes spectral and Riesz-representer bounds, and certifies POD, reduced-basis and POD-NN surrogates with a three-stage residual certificate. Every number in the paper is stored in a self-describing JSON file under results/; bash build.sh rebuilds every table and figure from these files, and scripts/check_numbers.py checks the numbers in the manuscript against them. The large files (reference trajectories, POD bases, offline tensors, network checkpoints) are archived in a separate Zenodo dataset record.
